import ctypes

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define constants from the GSL library
GSL_IEEE_SINGLE_PRECISION = 0
GSL_IEEE_DOUBLE_PRECISION = 1
GSL_IEEE_EXTENDED_PRECISION = 2

GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_NEAREST = 0
GSL_IEEE_ROUND_DOWN = 1
GSL_IEEE_ROUND_UP = 2
GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_ZERO = 3

GSL_IEEE_MASK_INVALID = 0x01
GSL_IEEE_MASK_DENORMALIZED = 0x02
GSL_IEEE_MASK_DIVISION_BY_ZERO = 0x04
GSL_IEEE_MASK_OVERFLOW = 0x08
GSL_IEEE_MASK_UNDERFLOW = 0x10
GSL_IEEE_TRAP_INEXACT = 0x20

GSL_SUCCESS = 0

# Define the function prototype
gsl.gsl_ieee_set_mode.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int]
gsl.gsl_ieee_set_mode.restype = ctypes.c_int

def set_ieee_mode(precision, rounding, exception_mask):
    """
    Set the IEEE floating-point mode using the GSL library.

    Args:
        precision (int): Precision mode (e.g., GSL_IEEE_SINGLE_PRECISION).
        rounding (int): Rounding mode (e.g., GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_NEAREST).
        exception_mask (int): Exception mask (e.g., GSL_IEEE_MASK_INVALID).

    Returns:
        int: Result of the function call (GSL_SUCCESS on success).
    """
    result = gsl.gsl_ieee_set_mode(precision, rounding, exception_mask)
    return result

def assert_test():
    """Run assertion tests to validate the implementation."""
    # Test case 1: Set single precision, round to nearest, no exceptions
    result = set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_SINGLE_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_NEAREST, 0)
    assert result == GSL_SUCCESS, f"Test case 1 failed: {result}"

    # Test case 2: Set double precision, round down, mask invalid exception
    result = set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_DOUBLE_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_DOWN, GSL_IEEE_MASK_INVALID)
    assert result == GSL_SUCCESS, f"Test case 2 failed: {result}"

    # Test case 3: Set extended precision, round up, mask multiple exceptions
    exception_mask = GSL_IEEE_MASK_INVALID | GSL_IEEE_MASK_OVERFLOW | GSL_IEEE_MASK_UNDERFLOW
    result = set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_EXTENDED_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_UP, exception_mask)
    assert result == GSL_SUCCESS, f"Test case 3 failed: {result}"

    # Test case 4: Invalid precision (should default to extended precision)
    result = set_ieee_mode(999, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_ZERO, 0)
    assert result == GSL_SUCCESS, f"Test case 4 failed: {result}"

    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
